meta.name: subagent-driven-development
meta.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大计划拆出的独立任务分派给子代理同时开工,快速推完实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一份拆好的实现计划,想让子代理分头把任务做完
copy.tagline_en: Dispatch independent tasks from a plan to subagents and get implementation done faster
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a broken-down implementation plan and want subagents to finish the tasks

howto.what: 按你给的实现计划,逐个任务派发全新的子代理去实现、测试并提交,每个任务后按规格与代码质量审查,全部跑完再做整分支终审;进度写进 ledger 文件,任务之间不停下询问。
howto.when: 当你有一份任务基本独立的实现计划、想在本会话里执行,且没有选择内联执行或缺少 subagent 工具时,它会接管执行。

say.text: 按这份计划执行,每个任务派一个子代理,做完就审查。
say.note: 先建 worktree 和 ledger,再逐任务派发。

say.text: 任务之间有冲突自己裁决并记进 ledger,别停下来问我。
say.note: 决定以 Ruling 记入 ledger 后继续。

say.text: 所有任务跑完后做一次整分支终审,再收尾这个分支。
say.note: 终审用最强模型,之后收尾分支。

howto.what_en: With a plan in hand, Claude dispatches a fresh subagent per task to implement, test and commit, reviews each task for spec and quality, runs a final branch-wide review, and keeps progress in a ledger file, without pausing between tasks.
howto.when_en: Use it when you have an implementation plan whose tasks are mostly independent and want it executed in the current session, without choosing inline execution and with a subagent tool available.

say_en.text: Execute this plan: one subagent per task, review each when it's done
say_en.note: Sets up worktree and ledger, then dispatches each task

say_en.text: Rule on conflicts yourself, log them in the ledger, don't stop to ask me
say_en.note: Decisions are recorded as rulings and work continues

say_en.text: After all tasks, run one whole-branch final review, then finish the branch
say_en.note: Final reviewer runs on the most capable model
